mappings.title: Group mappings
mappings.failed: Group mappings could not be loaded.
mappings.settingsFailed: Your plan could not be checked.
mappings.how: When someone signs in with single sign-on, their identity-provider groups are matched against these tables. A group with both a department and a level grants that department at that level; a group with a role grants that role.
mappings.additive: Mappings only add access: removing a mapping or a group never takes access away (change that on the person's page). They apply at each person's next SSO sign-in.
mappings.trial: SSO is available after you upgrade.
mappings.upgrade: Single sign-on and group mappings are included in the Pro and Enterprise plans.
mappings.dept.title: Groups to departments
mappings.dept.hint: A group needs both a department and a level to grant access.
mappings.dept.empty: No group is mapped to a department yet.
mappings.dept.partial: The departments were saved, but the levels were not. Nothing else changed. Retry the rest.
mappings.role.title: Groups to roles
mappings.role.empty: No group is mapped to a role yet.
mappings.role.ownerRow: Only an owner can change an owner mapping.
mappings.error.tooMany: A list can have up to 500 groups.
mappings.error.groupRequired: Every row needs a group name.
mappings.error.groupLong: A group name can be up to 255 bytes.
mappings.error.duplicate: Each group can appear once in a list.
mappings.error.owner: Only an owner can change an owner mapping.
mappings.subtitle: Map your identity provider's groups to departments, levels and roles, so people get the right access when they sign in with SSO.
